global_qa_strategies.strategy: Submit form with empty inputs to verify explicit client/server validation feedback messages.
Test negative numbers (-1), zero (0), and extreme values (9999999) to verify price calculation and inventory guardrails.
Inject special characters (<script>alert(1)</script>, ' OR '1'='1) to test XSS and SQL injection robustness.
Test invalid email formats and weak passwords to verify security error messaging.
Verify that subtotal + tax/VAT - discount equals grand total with 2-decimal precision.

Enforce strict workflow sequence: Vehicle Inspection -> Quotation -> Job Card / Work Order -> Invoice & Billing. Flag any flow forcing Quotation creation BEFORE Vehicle Inspection as a Logical Process Mismatch.
